review.editorial: Reviewed the station scene and its change of atmosphere; established the wet footwear, corrected the elapsed-day callback and fixed a seating action that lacked a physical setup.
review.continuity_or_facts: Added a witnessed introduction before a new character uses the student’s background. Checked the day’s locations, departure of an independent traveller, personal expense and attributed competing accounts; no pending decision is presented as completed.
review.english_alignment: Reviewed contextual growth, modal and particle readings and every local gloss. Phone pinyin opening, character middle/ending and desktop pinyin show meaningful English and unclipped punctuation.

samples.notes: Phone pinyin opening: source and English remain legible through the first sentence and transition, with readable colours and punctuation.
Phone character middle: dialogue/narration wrap with meaningful English beneath the source lines, without visible clipping.
Phone character ending: the closing source fragment and corresponding English are visible above the footer; no English-free paragraph unit.
Desktop pinyin middle: inspected word spacing, punctuation and English wrapping in the actual reader; guides remain readable.
